title: Is Controlling the News Media a Sign of Dictatorship? Press Freedom and India's Constitution
seoTitle: Is Media Control a Sign of Dictatorship? India Explained
seoDescription: How dictatorships control the press, how regulation differs from control, what Article 19 and the Supreme Court say, and India's 2026 press freedom rank.
excerpt: A side-by-side look at regulation versus control, a dated timeline from Glavlit to Russia's 2022 law, landmark Supreme Court rulings, India's RSF and Freedom House scores, and a checklist for readers.
